steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Apply an RFQ template so the pricing sheet and savings controls are available.
Add the specified CYLINDER product; its mapped Variant 1 should populate from the product selection.

args.goal: On the buyer's single-stage RFQ create screen, open Savings, add the Budget savings strategy once, attempt to add the same Budget strategy a second time, and stop with the refusal message visible.

steps.note: Perform the savings interaction that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Assert that Procol refused the duplicate savings strategy.
